decisions.reason: The Aave yield behavior is already captured by a complete same-message INTRODUCE Event.
The prior state already contains the $5 automatic immediate unlimited commission rules, and the same-message MODIFY already captures that earnings do not expire.
The source does not resolve automatic delivery versus manual claim, and the same-message AMBIGUOUS Event already records that unresolved choice.
The source explicitly revises the About page, not the independently maintained FAQ, so overlapping descriptions do not necessarily change FAQ content.
The About-page revision does not specify any change to NFT state transfer on resale.
The source reiterates that the mint number is the referral code and can be shared by number or link, all of which are already represented in the candidate state.
The source repeats the existing $15 mint price but does not change the current revenue-allocation rules.
The source restates the existing allocation of the $5 commission to a random existing NFT holder when no code is supplied.
The stated five $10,000 prizes every 50,000 primary or secondary sales already match the candidate's current Big Block state.
Chainlink VRF randomness and fair selection are already represented in the candidate state, and the source introduces no changed selection rule.
The stated five $500 prizes every 500 primary or secondary sales already match the candidate's current Small Block state.
The source mentions referral codes, tickets, and badges descriptively but does not change which attributes or counters must appear in NFT metadata.
